open_threads.title: S3 Subdomain Takeover on e2e.infra.rootz.com serving gambling spam
open_threads.detail: The S3 bucket at e2e.infra.rootz.com has been taken over and is actively serving a gambling/slot website ('IMBAJP | Maxwin Slot'). DNS CNAMEs to S3 website hosting IPs. The bucket serves malicious Indonesian-language gambling content with Etsy page templates, Google Tag Manager, and Bing tracking injected. Content last modified 2026-02-12. This represents an active compromise under the rootz.com domain with reputational damage and potential phishing/SEO poisoning impact. S3 error pages confirm standard bucket hosting. HTTP-only (HTTPS times out).

open_threads.title: Unauthenticated Prometheus /metrics on 6 lab1.rootz.com game servers
open_threads.detail: pragmatic-server, hacksaw-server, yggdrasil-server, quickspin-server, oryx-server, and push-server all expose /metrics without authentication. Discloses internal service URLs (backendapi.rootz-platform:7777), API route patterns (/rgs/hive/player/auth, /rgs/hive/player/{playerId}/wallet, /rgs/hive/txn), database config, AMQP infrastructure, Go version, wallet API operation counters, and process telemetry.

open_threads.title: Dex Device Code Flow open for phishing on staging OIDC
open_threads.detail: The Dex OIDC provider at dex.stg.rootz.com allows generating device codes via POST to /device/code without requiring a client_secret. An attacker could generate device codes (format XXXX-XXXX, 5min expiry) and trick users into approving them at the /device verification page, obtaining OIDC tokens for the staging Kubernetes cluster. The device flow combined with the dex-k8s-authenticator at login.stg.rootz.com creates a viable k8s credential phishing chain. Known client_id: wohTei2hiQu1. Google is the only configured connector.

open_threads.title: Kubernetes token generator and OIDC infrastructure publicly exposed
open_threads.detail: login.stg.rootz.com exposes a dex-k8s-authenticator for generating Kubernetes tokens for the staging cluster. Combined with the Dex OIDC provider, this reveals the complete authentication chain for the staging k8s cluster. OAuth client_id (wohTei2hiQu1) is disclosed, directory listing is enabled on /static/, security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options) are missing. The /callback endpoint is live and processes OAuth codes.

open_threads.title: assets.rootz.com S3 bucket listing with public file read
open_threads.detail: Full S3 bucket listing enabled (IsTruncated: true, 1000+ objects across 10+ brand directories). Individual files are publicly readable. Exposes brand asset structure, Apple Pay merchant certificates (Team ID: SL88LHPJ78), file metadata (ETags, timestamps). Bucket: assets.rootz.com, region: eu-west-1, ARN: arn:aws:s3:::assets.rootz.com. Brands exposed: beazt.com, caxino.com, chipz.com, lemonz.com, speedz.com, spinz.com, spinz.de, wheelz.com, wheelzgames.de, wildz.com, wildz.de.

open_threads.title: s-game-assets.rootz.com S3 bucket listing exposure
open_threads.detail: Full S3 bucket listing enabled with 1000+ game asset entries (IsTruncated: true). Individual file access returns 403 but listing exposes game IDs, internal naming conventions, and metadata. Bucket: s-game-assets.rootz.com, region: eu-west-1, ARN: arn:aws:s3:::s-game-assets.rootz.com.

open_threads.title: frontendapi.rootz.com multi-tenant API with wildcard CORS and tenant auth bypass potential
open_threads.detail: Multi-tenant API returns 401 'Missing tenant' on /api and /api/v1. Has wildcard CORS (access-control-allow-origin: *) with access-control-allow-credentials: true. Once valid tenant identifier is found, this is the primary API surface for the casino platform. Tenant isolation bypass, IDOR, or auth bypass are high-priority test areas.

open_threads.title: Game provider POST-only API servers accessible without auth on lab1 environment
open_threads.detail: Multiple game provider servers (pragmatic, hacksaw) accept POST to root and return 405 for GET, indicating active API endpoints. Combined with leaked route patterns from metrics, crafted POST requests could interact with wallet and player session APIs.

open_threads.title: content.rootz.com and s-content.rootz.com broken Cloudflare Workers
open_threads.detail: Both return HTTP 500 with empty JSON body ({}) for all paths. Cloudflare Workers with cf-placement remote-LHR and local-ORD. Allows GET/HEAD/POST/OPTIONS. Backend appears misconfigured or disconnected. POST method acceptance on a content API may indicate a writable API surface.

open_threads.title: wsapi.rootz.com/ws token-based WebSocket authentication endpoint
open_threads.detail: Production WebSocket API at wsapi.rootz.com/ws returns 401 'missing token' - confirms active auth endpoint. If tokens from lab/staging environments or leaked sessions could be used here, this could provide real-time access to the platform's push notification or game state channels.

open_threads.title: www.rootz.com WordPress with missing security headers and origin bypass potential
open_threads.detail: Corporate site runs WordPress with Kadence theme and Kadence Blocks Pro behind BunnyCDN. OpenResty origin disclosed on 301s. No HSTS, no CSP, no X-Frame-Options. wp-content/uploads accessible. Origin IP discovery could bypass CDN protections.

open_threads.title: uptime.rootz.com Laravel application with permissive CSP
open_threads.detail: Public Laravel app behind Caddy with CSP allowing unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval. XSRF-TOKEN and session cookies present. May expose Laravel debug routes (/telescope, /_debugbar, /horizon).

open_threads.title: status.rootz.com JSON API with wildcard CORS and multiple HTTP methods
open_threads.detail: JSON API at status.rootz.com accepts GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS with wildcard CORS. Route enumeration needed to find writable or data-leaking endpoints.
